{"code":"import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from scipy.stats import ttest_ind
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests

# Attempt to import gseapy, install if needed
try:
    import gseapy as gp
except ImportError:
    import subprocess, sys
    subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "--quiet", "gseapy"])
    import gseapy as gp

# 1. Load data
clin = pd.read_csv('cleaned_clinical_data.csv', low_memory=False)
expr = pd.read_csv('cleaned_gene_expression.csv', index_col=0)

# 2. Filter patients with non-missing ulceration indicator
clin_f = clin[clin['ulceration_indicator'].isin(['YES', 'NO'])]
clin_f = clin_f[['bcr_patient_barcode', 'ulceration_indicator', 'age_at_diagnosis', 'gender']]

# 3. Map samples to patients and merge
samples = expr.columns.to_series()
patient_ids = samples.str[:12]
sample_meta = pd.DataFrame({'sample': samples.values, 'bcr_patient_barcode': patient_ids.values})
meta = sample_meta.merge(clin_f, on='bcr_patient_barcode')
# Keep only matched samples
expr_f = expr[meta['sample']]

# 4. Compile immune gene panel from MSigDB Hallmark immune-related sets
hallmark = gp.get_library(name='Hallmark', organism='Human')
immune_sets = [
    'HALLMARK_INFLAMMATORY_RESPONSE',
    'HALLMARK_INTERFERON_ALPHA_RESPONSE',
    'HALLMARK_INTERFERON_GAMMA_RESPONSE',
    'HALLMARK_IL6_JAK_STAT3_SIGNALING',
    'HALLMARK_TNFA_SIGNALING_VIA_NFKB'
]
immune_genes = set()
for s in immune_sets:
    immune_genes.update(hallmark.get(s, []))
immune_genes = list(immune_genes & set(expr_f.index))

# 5. Compute immune module score (mean expression) per sample
scores = expr_f.loc[immune_genes].mean(axis=0)
meta = meta.set_index('sample')
meta['immune_score'] = scores
meta = meta.reset_index()

# 6. Compare ulcerated vs non-ulcerated
plt.figure(figsize=(6,4))
sns.boxplot(x='ulceration_indicator', y='immune_score', data=meta)
sns.swarmplot(x='ulceration_indicator', y='immune_score', data=meta, color='0.2', size=3)
plt.title('Immune Module Score by Ulceration Status')
plt.xlabel('Ulceration Indicator')
plt.ylabel('Mean Immune Gene Expression')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

scores_yes = meta.loc[meta['ulceration_indicator']=='YES', 'immune_score']
scores_no = meta.loc[meta['ulceration_indicator']=='NO', 'immune_score']
t_stat, p_val = ttest_ind(scores_yes, scores_no, nan_policy='omit')
print(f"Immune score t-test p-value: {p_val:.3e}")

# 7. Differential expression for immune genes (linear model with covariates)
de_results = []
for gene in immune_genes:
    df = meta[['sample','ulceration_indicator','age_at_diagnosis','gender']].copy()
    df['expr'] = expr_f.loc[gene, df['sample']].values
    model = smf.ols('expr ~ C(ulceration_indicator) + age_at_diagnosis + C(gender)', data=df).fit()
    coef = model.params.get('C(ulceration_indicator)[T.YES]', np.nan)
    p = model.pvalues.get('C(ulceration_indicator)[T.YES]', np.nan)
    de_results.append((gene, coef, p))

de_df = pd.DataFrame(de_results, columns=['gene','logFC','pvalue']).dropna()
de_df['FDR'] = multipletests(de_df['pvalue'], method='fdr_bh')[1]
de_sig = de_df[de_df['FDR'] < 0.05].sort_values('FDR')
print("\nDifferentially expressed immune genes (FDR < 0.05):")
print(de_sig)

# 8. Volcano plot for immune genes
plt.figure(figsize=(6,4))
usig = de_df['FDR'] < 0.05
plt.scatter(de_df['logFC'], -np.log10(de_df['pvalue']), c=usig.map({True:'red', False:'grey'}), alpha=0.7)
plt.xlabel('Log Fold Change (YES vs NO)')
plt.ylabel('-Log10(p-value)')
plt.title('Volcano Plot: Immune Genes')
plt.axhline(-np.log10(0.05), color='blue', linestyle='--')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# 9. GSEA preranked on all genes (t-statistic)
# Split expression by group
yes_samples = meta.loc[meta['ulceration_indicator']=='YES', 'sample']
no_samples = meta.loc[meta['ulceration_indicator']=='NO', 'sample']
t_stats, _ = ttest_ind(expr_f[yes_samples].values, expr_f[no_samples].values, axis=1, nan_policy='omit')
rnk = pd.Series(t_stats, index=expr_f.index).sort_values(ascending=False)
# Run prerank GSEA for immune sets
pre_res = gp.prerank(rnk=rnk, gene_sets={s: hallmark[s] for s in immune_sets}, processes=4,
                     permutation_num=100, outdir=None, seed=42, verbose=False)
print("\nGSEA results (immune pathways):")
print(pre_res.res2d[['es','nes','pval','fdr']])"}
